# MCP surface

JSON-RPC 2.0 over one HTTP route. initialize, tools/list, tools/call.

No OAuth. It is one user with a device token, and an authorization server
would be more code than the whole rest of the server.

Five tools: search_notes, read_note, append_note, record_session, today.
